analytics.name: Analytic 1804
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Process Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir('/proc/') with recursive listdir by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$ on device with android_version /status or /proc//cmdline by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: System diagnostic tools, MDM agent. Minimal.
7.0 (Nougat) — hidepid enabled. Derive from MDM OS version telemetry.

log_sources.name: mobile:ForensicArtifacts
log_sources.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir('/proc/') with recursive listdir by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$ on device with android_version < $HidepidVersion$

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: running process names read from /proc/<PID>/status or /proc/<PID>/cmdline by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$

analytics.name: Analytic 1805
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Process Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 300s — time in which C2 expected post-jailbreak on non-managed device.

log_sources.channel: DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries
